title: MAP LABEL FILE TO VOLUME
description: Maps labels from a gifti label file into a volume file.  You must specify exactly one mapping method option.  The -nearest-vertex method uses the label from the vertex closest to the voxel center.  The -ribbon-constrained method uses the same method as in -volume-to-surface-mapping, then uses the weights in reverse, with popularity logic to decide on a label to use.

surface.description: the surface to use coordinates from

volume_space.description: a volume file in the desired output volume space

nearest_vertex.description: use the label from the vertex closest to the voxel center

inner_surf.description: the inner surface of the ribbon

outer_surf.description: the outer surface of the ribbon

voxel_subdiv.description: voxel divisions while estimating voxel weights

greedy.description: also put labels in voxels with less than 50% partial volume (legacy behavior)
